name: Serve Board

persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Grace, 60, the volunteer coordinator at a church in Illinois. Last Sunday nobody was at the door to greet people and the nursery had no helper. Today you want the next Sundays planned, so everyone knows their job early.

challenge.intro: Now you are Grace, the volunteer coordinator. The board is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press — use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Serve Board with the normal link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If it does not show, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. Do NOT use the '↻ Start fresh' button near the top: it only empties the Sundays and keeps old people. After this, 👥 My people says 'Nobody yet' and every job says 'needs someone'.

tasks.text: Your volunteers are Linda, Tom and Carol. Put all three in the app.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: plans which volunteer does which job on each Sunday
shows empty jobs early (orange) so you can find someone in time
keeps your people, what they can do, and lets you tell them they are serving

personaChurch.title: Pretend you are…
personaChurch.text: Pretend you are Grace, 60, the church secretary. The pastor has asked you to organize the Sunday volunteers, because last Sunday nobody was at the door to greet people and the nursery had no helper. Today you want the next Sundays planned, so everyone knows their job early.

introChurch: Now you are Grace, the church secretary. The board is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press — use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.

lines: This short video explains Serve Board. You have never seen it before, and that is fine. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. Every Sunday a church needs a lot of volunteers. Someone welcomes people at the door. Someone looks after the babies. Someone runs the sound. Someone makes the coffee.
Usually the plan lives in one person's head, or on scraps of paper. Then on Sunday morning a job is empty, and the same few people cover it again.
Serve Board puts the whole month of volunteers on one page. You see every empty job weeks early, and can ask someone in good time.
Who uses it? Whoever schedules volunteers: a church office, a ministry leader, a youth group, a choir, or a school club.
Let us look at the screen. The big part of the page is the board. Each Sunday has its own card, with the date at the top and the list of jobs below.
Next to each job is a button. If nobody has that job yet, it is orange and says needs someone. Orange means: find a person.
Along the top are the buttons: Add a Sunday, My people, Roles and requirements, Print, and Start fresh.
Start with your people. Tap My people, then tap Add a person, and type a name. You can also add a phone number and an email.
Under each person is a line called Can serve as. Tap the jobs this person can do. Green means yes. If you tap none, the app thinks they can do any job.
Already have a list in a spreadsheet? Tap Import from a spreadsheet, paste the rows, and everyone comes in at once.
Next, the jobs. Tap Roles and requirements. You can rename a job, remove one, or tap Add a role.
Under each job you can write what it requires, for example a background check. The app shows that reminder every time you put someone in that job.
Now fill the board. Tap an orange button that says needs someone.
A box opens. At the top are your people who can do this job. Tap a name. Or type a new name and tap Put them in.
Then the app shows a short message for that person, so they know they are serving that Sunday. If you saved their phone number, one tap texts it. You can also email it, or copy it.
Tap Done, back to the board. The orange button is now white, with the person's name in it. Tap a name any time to change it or clear the slot.
Need more weeks? Tap Add a Sunday. Sundays that have passed fold away by themselves.
Need paper for the bulletin board? Tap Print. You get a clean copy of the board, without the buttons.
Start fresh near the top only clears the names off the board, after asking. Your people and jobs stay.
How to start? Add three or four people, then fill next Sunday. That is your first two minutes, and the board already looks less empty.
Privacy: everything stays on this phone. There is no account, and nothing is sent unless you send the message yourself.
Serve Board is nineteen dollars, once. Profits help students in Kenya stay in school.
And the question mark button in the corner has the tour and help, any time you need them.
